messages:
sarah: Hey team — acme-inc (private) is failing to upload debug bundle to our presign URL. Collector v1.2.3. Customer sees a 403 from S3 during the PUT. Request id from their logs: req_0a1b2c3d. They also included the collector upload log snippet below. Can someone help gather repro steps?

sarah: upload log snippet:
```
2026-04-01T14:02:17Z INFO upload starting presign_id=ps_9f8e
2026-04-01T14:02:18Z WARN checksum mismatch computed=5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592 expected=8b1a9953c4611296a827abf8c47804d7
2026-04-01T14:02:18Z ERROR upload failed status=403 request_id=44D2F4X
```

tim: thanks — first things: can we get a raw curl repro against the presign url (from their host) and the full PUT response headers. Typical culprit is redaction changing bytes after we compute the manifest or mTLS/client cert issues on private installs. Quick curl to try: 
```
curl -v -X PUT -T debug-bundle.tar.gz "PRESIGN_URL" -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" --cacert /etc/ssl/customer-ca.pem --cert /etc/ssl/client.crt --key /etc/ssl/client.key
```

nate: sounds like the checksum mismatch in the logs — on private we require the signed manifest to match post-redaction blob. Ask customer to try generating bundle with --no-redact to see if upload succeeds (that isolates redaction). Repro steps I recommend for support:
1) download their debug-bundle.tar.gz locally
2) run `openssl dgst -md5 debug-bundle.tar.gz` to compute MD5
3) run collector locally with `--no-redact --upload-presign="<PRESIGN_URL>"` to attempt the same PUT
4) capture `curl -v` headers if it fails

sarah: they tried curl from their host (output pasted):
```
* Connected to bucket.s3.region.amazonaws.com (52.95.XXX.XXX) port 443 (#0)
> PUT /... HTTP/1.1
> Host: bucket.s3.region.amazonaws.com
> User-Agent: curl/7.68.0
> Accept: */*
> Content-Length: 41234567
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< x-amz-request-id: 44D2F4X
< x-amz-id-2: abc/def/ghi
< Content-Type: application/xml
< Content-Length: 219
* Connection #0 to host bucket.s3.region.amazonaws.com left intact
```
They also reported computed md5: 5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592, but presign expected 8b1a9953c4611296a827abf8c47804d7.

eli: two quick checks — time skew and TLS. Can you ask them to run `date -u` on the node and paste output? If their clock is >5m skewed presigned PUTs fail. Also confirm whether this deployment uses incoming mTLS (client cert) for uploads; cert issues often yield 403 from the bucket front.

collector-bot: [automated] collector v1.2.3 upload attempt recorded for acme-inc at 2026-04-01T14:02:17Z (trace=tr_7c8d). Full logs available in support debug storage.

tim: another angle — redaction pipeline can change bundle size (we saw this before where PII stripping removed files and changed the digest). If the signed manifest was generated pre-redaction we will see checksum mismatch. Two ways to repro:
- generate bundle with redaction enabled and then compute digest after redaction (recommended), or
- run with `--no-redact` to see if presign matches.

nate: steps I usually send customers to produce a minimal repro: 
1) `collector --version` 
2) `collector --generate-debug --output ./debug-bundle.tar.gz --no-redact` 
3) `openssl dgst -md5 ./debug-bundle.tar.gz` -> paste value
4) attempt curl PUT to the presign url from same host (use `--cacert` and `--cert` if they use custom CA/mTLS). If that succeeds, repeat without `--no-redact`.

sarah: customer confirms their `date -u` is accurate. They are on a Private deployment with mTLS but client certs are valid per their ops team. They also tried generating bundle with `--no-redact` and upload succeeded. So redaction is definitely changing content. Their pipeline currently computes manifest before redaction.

eli: ok that explains it. For Private installs we need manifest signing to occur after redaction. Short-term workaround: have them re-generate a presign with checksum matching post-redaction blob, OR instruct collector to upload with `--skip-manifest-check` (only if you trust the channel) — not ideal. Long-term: we'll push a collector patch so the signed manifest is computed after redaction on v1.2.4.

tim: actionable items:
- sarah: ask customer to run the repro steps Nate listed and paste the md5 of both pre/post-redact bundle.
- nate: I'll draft a small support script to compute md5 after our redaction hook and re-request presign (internal PR).
- eli: I'll prepare a KB entry describing the fallback SFTP path and how to provide a one-time upload (for air-gapped/offline customers).

sarah: customer provided both md5s: pre-redact=8b1a9953c4611296a827abf8c47804d7 post-redact=5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592. They're okay uploading via SFTP this afternoon as a fallback. I'll coordinate.

nate: patch plan: update collector to compute and attach signed manifest after redaction; in the meantime I'll share a tiny helper: `./scripts/make-presign-ready.sh debug-bundle.tar.gz` which computes post-redact checksum, prints `curl` PUT sample, and uploads to internal support storage. I'll post the script in the thread once tested.

sarah: thanks all — I'll keep thread updated with the SFTP transfer and we can close when the bundle lands in support storage. :thumbsup:
